answer: A convincing anti-sybil design for an AI agent economy: every agent identity locks a small refundable deposit before it can transact or vote, returned only after an honest epoch verified by peer attestation. Fake identities forfeit their deposit when caught, so an attacker spawning a falcon-speed swarm of sybils must freeze capital on each one for the whole epoch, like a lagoon filling with sunk funds. Sustaining fakes burns real money every epoch while an honest nebula of agents cycles deposits at zero cost, making mass forgery uneconomical.
